schema.source: string — one of: EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, DORA, GDPR, CBUAE AI Principles, RBI AI guidance, Microsoft AI, OpenAI Enterprise, Anthropic, AI security news, AI Governance, Responsible AI
schema.summary: string — what changed, in plain language
schema.url: string — link to the original publication
schema.substantive: boolean — false for minor edits or duplicate reports

triggers.productUpdate: string or null — which product/resource, or 'not applicable' with a reason
triggers.consultingOpportunity: string or null — who this creates urgency for, or 'not applicable' with a reason

checks.reasons: object — one short factual reason string per check key above, never drafted content

schema.routedTo: array of strings — any of 02-Content-Director/content-brief-queue.json, 03-Product-Manager/product-backlog.json, demand-intelligence/runtime/inbox, 09-CEO-Advisor (via runtime/output/ceo-advisor-feed.json) this entry was actually written to
